# Linux DML21 reference vectors for amdgpu_dcn401_dml.rs `admit_all` with
# GFX12 tiled, DCC and 4:2:0 (NV12, P010) planes; retained regression snapshot
# (fixture schema, RAISED); retained policy inputs
# Retained input grammar follows plane_vectors.txt, each
# plane followed by: source (0 RGB, 1 dml2_420_8, 2 dml2_420_10), swizzle
# (0 linear, 1 256B_2D, 2 4KB_2D, 3 64KB_2D, 4 256KB_2D), DCC (1 with
# independent 64B blocks), rotation (1 and 3 scan vertically) and a 4:2:0
# plane's chroma surface width, height and pitch (amdgpu_dm's half-size
# chroma plane, pitches[1] in chroma pixels), viewport, ratios and taps.
# Pitches are whole macro tiles (linear: 256-byte rows on each plane). The
# viewports, ratios and taps are what SPL picks with EASF on: an RGB plane
# six taps when scaled and one at 1:1; a 4:2:0 luma one tap at 1:1 and six
# when scaled, its chroma four at half the luma ratio (the DET-limit lines
# use four taps throughout). Results: each plane's 62 plane_vectors.txt
# values, then 90 more: the chroma DLG/TTU delivery, luma and chroma
# rq_regs, expansion modes, plane1_base_address, unbounded_request_enabled,
# allow_sdpif_rate_limit_when_cstate_req, the DCC mcache allocation (counts,
# all DML2_MAX_MCACHES + 1 boundaries and global ids of each surface,
# last-slice sharing) and four pipes' mcache registers, each pipe's
# viewports SPL's on its ODM segment or MPC slice (spl_viewport.c); or
# "! REJECT" or "! ClockState" where DPMM would raise DCFCLK/FCLK. A DCC
# plane whose mcaches one pipe cannot place is planned on two MPC-combined
# pipes ("/2" and the pipe-0 blank end), or on a single ODM stream gets one
# more ODM pipe (PMO's dynamic ODM, as DC runs it).

# Single-stream ODM with DCC planes of 2 to 4 mcaches (8K60 at 2 GHz and
# 4K120 at 1 GHz DISPCLK: ODM 2:1; 8K60 at 1 GHz: 3:1), 4KB, 64KB and 256KB
# swizzles, 4 and 8 bytes per pixel, unrotated and rotated, on 4, 8 and 16
# channels. A plane whose mcaches its ODM pipes cannot place has its
# stream's ODM factor raised by pmo_dcn4_fams2_optimize_dcc_mcache
